root_text:
"Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) causes respiratory infections, especially in kids, older adults, and the immunocompromised. Symptoms range from colds to severe pneumonia. Wash hands & avoid close contact when sick. #HMPV"
Via #LaiqVerse
